scope: Synthetic numerical admission regression only; no historical science campaign or held-out data will be re-executed
observed_defects: One declared sample with a rank-seven augmented Gram is accepted
String matrix entries are admitted by JSON but refused by the lossless binary codec
intended_changes: Require exact bounded plain-float matrix representation before array coercion
Require numerical rank of the augmented Gram to be no larger than the declared sample count at the existing PSD tolerance

controls: Impossible rank must reject before any ledger mutation

Real rank-deficient, full-rank and zero sufficient statistics must remain accepted
JSON and binary admission must agree on producer representation and count consistency
Retain all 17 prior synthetic ledger/codec/peer controls and add the new explicit tests to the same regression gate
limits: Algebraic feasibility and byte representation do not authenticate sample provenance, resist valid-data poisoning, establish useful work, or prove training speedup
